caveat: No true git-diff was possible. This is a structural snapshot of the file's CURRENT (main-branch) content plus any changelog-confirmed version deltas.
current_content_summary: dbool (the uniform {0,1} distribution) is defined by CLONING Distr.MFinite at type bool with enum <- [true; false] and card <- 2, RENAMING the clone's dunifin to dbool and its dunifinE to dboolE_count. dboolE and dbool_leq are then proved directly. A `Biased` sub-theory defines dbiased p (a p-weighted coin, via clamp to keep p in [0,1]), with dbiased1E/dbiasedE/supp_dbiased/dbiased_ll/dbiased_fu, dmap_pred (relating dmap of a lossless distribution to a dbiased), and marginal_sampling_pred. `FixedBiased` is an abstract theory fixing p once via an axiom-like op declaration. `MUniFinFunBiased` handles biased-coin-per-index reasoning over a finite function type.
import_repair_note: The names dbool and dbool1E (etc.) are NOT primitive -- they are a renamed clone of Distr.MFinite's dunifin/dunifinE. A proof citing `dunifin`/`dunifinE` directly against DBool would need `dbool`/`dboolE_count` instead. Also, r2024.09: DBool lost `Cost` and `cdbool` to the cost-logic removal (commit 41c2667f, 'This diff removes the cost logic'). Those have no replacement -- `schema` stopped being a lexer keyword in the same commit, so a proof still carrying cost annotations fails with a parse error and the repair is to delete them.
